rubric: Tests Muon or a close orthogonalized-update variant against a tuned baseline. Reports accuracy or loss vs steps or epochs, not only final results after long training.
Gives concrete, transferable settings or ablations (momentum, lr, Newton-Schulz steps or coefficients, weight decay, schedule, parameter coverage, batch size) with measured effect sizes.
Measures in a regime relevant here: image convnets or small models, a short budget or large batch, ideally CIFAR-scale. Or it shows the effect does not depend on scale.
Reports or allows estimating the wall-clock or per-step overhead of the change, so that accuracy per second can be judged.
exclude: Methods that need pretrained weights, distillation from a pretrained teacher, or external data (forbidden by RULES.md)
Test-time augmentation or any use of the test set during training or selection
Work that only covers LLM pretraining at billion-parameter scale, with no ablation that transfers to small convnets
Second-order methods with heavy per-step cost (full Shampoo/SOAP preconditioner updates every step) and no amortized cheap variant
Proxy-based data filtering and coreset selection (already refuted, E016)
Stronger augmentation or cutout as the accuracy lever (refuted under Muon, E030)
